bio: This Palladian style Georgian country house mansion dates back to Saxons times. It sits in the middle of sixty aces of parkland. Colwick Hall is a grade II* listed manor with a grand entrance overlooking Nottingham racecourse.  Colwick Hall offers a traditional Afternoon Tea, with a generous selection of sandwiches, cakes, scones and teas.  This venue is located just two miles from Nottingham city centre and is easily accessible by M1, A1, A52, A46 and A612.
